patch.value: Idempotent import: match on Jira key, update instead of duplicate; persist jira_key/jira_url

author: codex

patch.value: Deferred (not in 2026-06-03 brief scope). buildExportPlan already detects existing Jira keys via provenance and emits PUT/update vs POST/create so re-EXPORT does not duplicate; jira_key/jira_url remain persisted in the description marker (#97: no custom-field setter). Full idempotent re-IMPORT (update matched pm items in place) is a larger change left for a future release to avoid destabilizing the working import path.
